Setting up Parley now starts with one choice, Cloud or Local, and the AI connection Parley shows follows it.

**Cloud or Local** (#687)

- **Cloud:** sign in and you're done with models. Parley's transcription and AI are set for you, so there's no model step to fill in.
- **Local:** no account. Use your own API keys or a model on this computer. Parley's hosted models aren't offered on this route, so nothing goes to Parley.
- You can switch later in Settings › Account. Moving to Cloud needs you signed in.
- If you already use Parley, nothing asks you to set up again. If you transcribe with Parley's hosted service, you're on Cloud; otherwise you're on Local.

**Connect your AI** (#687)

- **On Cloud,** Connect AI and Settings › MCP give you the cloud connector, `https://api.parley.tw/mcp`. Add it in Claude (Settings › Connectors › Add custom connector) on the web, desktop or phone, or in Claude Code with `claude mcp add --transport http parley https://api.parley.tw/mcp`. It reads the recordings synced to your account. The local server is still in Settings › MCP, under Local MCP (advanced).
- **On Local,** nothing changes: Parley's built-in server on this computer.
